description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android wearable flashlight app, including fragment management and user interaction logic.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry activity managing fragments and view pager for the flashlight app.

classes.name: LightFragmentAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing fragments within the view pager.

classes.name: WhiteLightFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the white light display.

classes.name: PartyLightFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing party light behavior with start/stop cycling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the view pager and fragments.

methods.name: addFragment
methods.description: Adds a fragment to the adapter and updates view pager.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment at the specified position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns total number of fragments managed.

methods.name: startCycling
methods.description: Starts the party light cycling effect.

methods.name: stopCycling
methods.description: Stops the party light cycling effect.
